Package org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure

package org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Migrations
    Finds the migrations to run, in the order they run.
    MigratoryAotProcessor
    Bakes the sorted migrations into a native image at build time.
    MigratoryAutoConfiguration
    Runs the migrations libraries declare in META-INF/migratory.properties at startup, before the application's own Liquibase.
    MigratoryDatabaseInitializerDetector
    Finds MigratoryLiquibase as a database initializer, ordered ahead of every other, so every SpringLiquibase bean, JPA, and each bean that depends on database initialization waits for the declared migrations.
    MigratoryFailureAnalyzer
    Reports a MigratoryException (a bad declaration, a cycle, two migrations with one name) as Spring Boot's short startup failure report instead of a stack trace.
    MigratoryLiquibase
    Runs the migrations libraries declare, in order, in one Liquibase update, before the application's own Liquibase.
    MigratoryProperties
    migratory's settings.
